description: Scoring engine for canonical 7-section audit reports. Scores an AuditReport-formatted markdown text against a case JSON oracle on 7 components: verdict matching, critical-point coverage, confidence calibration, discriminant tests, probative separation, weakness taxonomy, and fail-closed discipline. All output scores are LOCAL_LAB_ONLY heuristics — not calibrated probabilities.
function: 7-component weighted audit report scoring engine (verdicts, coverage, confidence, discriminant tests, separation, taxonomy, fail-closed)

inputs.name: oracle
inputs.description: Oracle dict for score_audit_report(); None uses auto-extracted oracle

inputs.name: strict
inputs.description: If True, return zero score when canonical validation fails

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Report text for extract_verdict() or extract_confidence()

inputs.name: report_sections
inputs.description: Parsed sections dict for component scoring functions

outputs.name: extract_sections
outputs.description: Section name to body text mapping

outputs.name: score_critical_points
outputs.description: Score, note, and uncovered points list

outputs.name: score_discriminant_tests
outputs.description: Score, note, and found test count

outputs.name: validate_case_json
outputs.description: List of validation issues (empty if valid)

outputs.name: evaluate
outputs.description: Full evaluation result with component scores, total, differences

outputs.name: score_audit_report
outputs.description: Score dict with total out of 100 and component breakdown

public_api.name: ComponentScores
public_api.signature: ComponentScores(global_and_subverdicts, critical_points_coverage, confidence_calibration, discriminant_tests, probative_separation, weakness_taxonomy, fail_closed_and_limitations)

public_api.name: extract_sections
public_api.description: Parse markdown into section_name to body dict using heading detection.

public_api.name: extract_verdict
public_api.signature: extract_verdict(text: str, allowed_verdicts: List[str] = DEFAULT_ALLOWED_VERDICTS) -> Optional[str]
public_api.description: Extract the global verdict from report text.

public_api.name: extract_confidence
public_api.description: Extract confidence score (x/10) from report text.

public_api.name: score_verdicts
public_api.signature: score_verdicts(report_text, report_sections, oracle, allowed_verdicts, max_points=20) -> Tuple[int, str, Dict]
public_api.description: Score global + sub-verdict matching against oracle.

public_api.name: score_critical_points
public_api.signature: score_critical_points(report_text, critical_points, max_points=20) -> Tuple[int, str, List[str]]
public_api.description: Score coverage of required critical points.

public_api.name: score_confidence
public_api.signature: score_confidence(actual, expected, tolerance, max_points=15) -> Tuple[int, str]
public_api.description: Score confidence calibration against expected value with tolerance bands.

public_api.name: score_discriminant_tests
public_api.signature: score_discriminant_tests(report_sections, oracle, max_points=15) -> Tuple[int, str, int]
public_api.description: Count discriminant tests in Detailed Analysis section.

public_api.name: score_probative_separation
public_api.description: Score presence of all 5 evidence channels (observation, theory, modeling, interpretation, inference).

public_api.name: score_fail_closed
public_api.description: Score fail-closed discipline in Limitations and Summary sections.

public_api.name: validate_case_json
public_api.description: Validate required fields and scoring consistency in a case JSON.

public_api.name: evaluate
public_api.signature: evaluate(case: Dict, report_text: str, strict: bool = False) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Evaluate a report markdown against a case JSON oracle. Returns full structured score dict.

public_api.name: score_audit_report
public_api.signature: score_audit_report(report_text: str, oracle: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]
public_api.description: Score a report text with a minimal default oracle (no sub-verdicts required). Returns score dict with total out of 100.
